$ rnsh --help
exit: Some(0)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage:
  rnsh -l [options] [-- command...]
  rnsh [options] <destination> [-- command...]

Options:
  -c, --config PATH        rnsh application config directory
      --rnsconfig PATH     Reticulum config directory
  -i, --identity PATH      Identity file to use
  -p, --print-identity     Print identity and destination info
  -Z, --base256            Also print compact base256 display for hashes
  -l, --listen             Listen for remote shell links
  -s, --service NAME       Listener identity service name
  -b, --announce PERIOD    Announce on startup and every PERIOD seconds (0 = once)
  -a, --allowed HASH       Allow initiator identity hash (repeatable)
  -n, --no-auth            Allow any initiator identity
  -A, --remote-command-as-args
  -C, --no-remote-command
  -N, --no-id              Do not identify to the listener
  -m, --mirror             Return remote command exit code
  -w, --timeout SECONDS    Path/link/protocol timeout
--- end

$ rnsh --version
exit: Some(0)
--- stdout
rnsh <VERSION> (protocol 1)
--- stderr
--- end

$ rnsh --no-such-option
exit: Some(1)
--- stdout
--- stderr
unknown option --no-such-option
Usage:
  rnsh -l [options] [-- command...]
  rnsh [options] <destination> [-- command...]

Options:
  -c, --config PATH        rnsh application config directory
      --rnsconfig PATH     Reticulum config directory
  -i, --identity PATH      Identity file to use
  -p, --print-identity     Print identity and destination info
  -Z, --base256            Also print compact base256 display for hashes
  -l, --listen             Listen for remote shell links
  -s, --service NAME       Listener identity service name
  -b, --announce PERIOD    Announce on startup and every PERIOD seconds (0 = once)
  -a, --allowed HASH       Allow initiator identity hash (repeatable)
  -n, --no-auth            Allow any initiator identity
  -A, --remote-command-as-args
  -C, --no-remote-command
  -N, --no-id              Do not identify to the listener
  -m, --mirror             Return remote command exit code
  -w, --timeout SECONDS    Path/link/protocol timeout
--- end
